candidate_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
  AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9.])\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E(?![A-Za-z0-9]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*')
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber
original_question: List CRs whose affected clauses match actual sections of spec 38.423 (clause-to-section validation).
